instruction: Fix `normalize` so it returns the NFC-normalised form (the current code returns the input unchanged, so decomposed forms are not composed).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -47,4 +47,4 @@
 
 def normalize(text):
     """Return the NFC-normalised form of ``text``."""
-    return text
+    return unicodedata.normalize("NFC", text)
